name: What are the steps involved in a professional shower tile installation?

mainEntity.name: What are the steps involved in a professional shower tile installation?

acceptedAnswer.text: Proper shower tile installation requires stripping the wet area down to the studs to inspect for water damage, installing solid backing like cement backer board, and applying an approved waterproofing membrane. The tile is then set with appropriate thinset mortar, grouted, and sealed with flexible silicone caulk along all internal corners. At HH Remodeling, owner Abraham Becerra leads on-site tile work and coordinates licensed plumbing trades to ensure rough-in valves and shower pans are fully secured and leak-tested before the first tile is placed. Skipping proper backing or waterproofing creates moisture issues behind the walls that rot framing.
acceptedAnswer.description: Professional shower tiling involves gutting to studs, installing cement backer board, applying a waterproof membrane, setting tile, grouting, and sealing corners.
